summary: Render-restart routine. Calls StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_21, 215) and, when its byte value is non-zero, logs "Entered Render Restart" via DebugLogWrite into dword_8AD25C. Then fills the 0x68-byte render state object pointed to by this with the byte pattern 0x01 and returns the integer 16843009.

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_21, 215); the low byte of its return value drives the logging guard.
Guard on the unsigned byte of the StringSplitLoop result: when non-zero, write the restart log message; when zero, skip logging.
Call DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredRenderR) to emit the entered-render-restart message.
Set the return value to the integer literal 16843009 before the state fill.
Fill the 0x68-byte object pointed to by this with the byte value 1 via memset.
